subject: pipeline pack: key oracle verified vs device, console record patch, replay mode; LEASE REQUEST (1 host compile+replay, jobs1)
body: FINDINGS (host-only, no device). (1) gpu/metal/tegu/pipeline_keys.py reimplements TPC-AIR-1/LIB/SPEC keys; luma_boost key c6d90ce8a16f4861 (c6jb) reproduced EXACTLY (QuartzCore QC metallib sha 11c74cc4..., spec identity with COUNT 0 for both functions, msgcap 512, profile = build/tegu-frontend/tegu-air-profile.h which is byte-identical to the profile inside the installed c6jb Mach-O). pipeline_corpus.py scan: all 15 non-fixed generic-MRT pipelines match in all four builds c6gc/c6hc/c6ic/c6jb, plus 2 fixed_frag pipelines (baseline constants, fc_attachment_count=2). (2) The console logs do NOT contain function-constant values (TEGU_FIXED_UI_FC lines exist in no log; TEGU_RENDER_* are emitted only for refused/fallback pipelines, cap 64/process; var=1/2 pipelines have no trace). c6jb: 66 unique AIR miss keys, 17 verified, 30 constants_unknown, 11 no_descriptor. fixed_frag_lph_cph has 58 constants (59 incl. vertex 4): brute force is not feasible, zero fill is not evidence. (3) MINIMAL LOGGING (implemented, my file pipeline_cache_frontend.inc, sha12 3d8d94f90e54): every AIR pipeline (miss AND hit, once per key per process, <=256) now also goes to the console as numbered 200-char chunks 'TEGU_PSO_REC k=<key16> src=<miss|mem|disk|pack> i=n/N <TPC_MISS v1 air record>' carrying library SHA, vspec/fspec (all constant values), targets, blends, attrs, layouts, profile hash, msgcap; misses.txt record unchanged. ~2.5KB/fixed record, expect ~150-250KB per boot. A second device boot of the next candidate then yields the complete constant set. Also host-only env TEGU_PIPELINE_CACHE_BUILD_OVERRIDE (TEGU_FRONTEND_HOST only) so replay can mint a pack for any build id. Changes build id (pipeline_cache_frontend.inc is in the compilers scope). (4) New files: metal/tegu/pipeline_keys.py, pipeline_corpus.py, pipeline_replay_host_test.inc (+3 lines in render_frontend_host_test.m: --pipeline-replay mode; no other edits). render owner: no edits to render_encoder.inc/n2r/bridge by me. (5) CAVEAT pack size: AIR entries ~0.6MB and fixed Mali ~0.6MB each; 100+ pipelines => tens of MB uncompressed in the pack (format has no compression). LEASE REQUEST to parent: one heavy host build (render_frontend_host_test.m, -O1 no sanitizer, nice -n10, jobs1, outputs in gpu/build/pipeline-pack-20261026/) then one bounded replay of 17 verified records (est. 2-5 min). Will not start until granted. Using host libs lowering-claude-20261025/lib-buftable (614e9b56) unless told otherwise.
